name: ppt-visual-reconstructor
description: Reconstruct and refine editable PowerPoint slides against reference images.

interface.shortDescription: Rebuild reference images as editable PowerPoint slides.
interface.longDescription: Reconstructs or repairs editable PowerPoint slides, renders them with desktop PowerPoint, compares the result with a reference image, and iteratively corrects layout, typography, imagery, and layering.
defaultPrompt: Reconstruct this reference image as an editable PowerPoint slide.
Repair this SVG-to-PowerPoint conversion and preserve selected images.
Compare this PPTX render with the reference and produce a correction plan.
